newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan temperatures seen average in Aug-Oct period.
newsitem.headline: Japan temperatures seen average in Aug-Oct period.

text.p: Temperatures in the August to October period are expected to be average for that time of the year in northern Japan and lower than usual in eastern and western Japan, the Meteorological Agency said on Tuesday.
Temperatures are also expected to be lower than usual in the southwestern islands.
August is expected to see many sunny days with some overcast days likely. Temperatures are expected to be low in northern, eastern and western Japan, and about average in the southwestern islands.
Rainfall is expected to be about average for that time of the year.
The weather in September is expected to change in cycles of several days, with some overcast days.
Temperatures are expected to be low in eastern and western Japan as well as the southwestern islands, and average in northern Japan.
Rainfall is expected to be heavy in northern, eastern and western Japan along the Pacific seaboard. It is expected to be about average in northern, eastern and western Japan along the Sea of Japan.

Many sunny days are expected in October. The temperature is expected to be high in northern Japan, and average in eastern and western Japan. It is expected to be low in the southwestern islands. Rainfall is expected to be about average.
